status.summary: Former UFC bantamweight champion, still ranked #1 at bantamweight and #9 pound-for-pound in the UFC media-panel rankings (Nov 3, 2026), on a two-fight losing streak, both losses to Petr Yan. He won the title from Sean O'Malley at UFC 306 (Sep 14, 2024) and defended it three times in 2025: Umar Nurmagomedov (UFC 311), O'Malley again by guillotine (UFC 316) and Cory Sandhagen (UFC 320). He lost the belt to Yan at UFC 323 (Dec 6, 2025; 46-49, 46-49, 47-48) and lost the trilogy at UFC 333 in Abu Dhabi (Oct 24, 2026; 47-48 on all three cards). Yahoo called it a come-from-behind win for Yan, and the ufcstats rounds fit Merab taking R1-R2 (5 of 19 takedowns) before going 0 of 39 in R3-R5. He fought UFC 333 on a nose broken in sparring in April 2026 that he chose not to have repaired. On Oct 26 he said he is healthy and will be back soon. No MMA bout is booked; his next outing is a freestyle wrestling match (not MMA) against Marlon Moraes at RAF Abu Dhabi on Nov 14, 2026, his fourth Real American Freestyle match (he beat Frankie Edgar and Henry Cejudo, then lost the Cejudo rematch on Aug 22, 2026). He is 35. Pro record 21-6 (UFCalendar, Wikipedia, MMA Junkie Nov 2); UFC record 14-4 per ufcstats.

opponents land 51% of their sig attempts on him (decayed) vs a 45.6% league average
style.summary: A relentless pressure fighter who mixes punching combinations with takedown attempts in bunches, and whose output rises in the late rounds of five-round fights. He is rarely taken down himself (76% takedown defence) and has never been stopped by strikes. Against Petr Yan the takedowns stopped landing and Yan's accuracy won the later rounds, which is the template for beating him.

moves.notes: Weights are relative within each target group, as src/director.js uses them: head moves sum to 1, body to 1, legs to 1. spinning, knee and elbow are separate rates for occasional specials. fighters.json time-decayed attempt split is 82.6% head, 9.1% body and 8.3% leg (landed 70.3/15.1/14.5), against a bantamweight average of 76.2/14.1/9.7. He is clearly head-heavy and throws few body and leg strikes. With 85.5% of decayed attempts at distance and 18.3 takedown attempts per 15 min career, the head group favours jabs, crosses and overhands thrown as entries to level changes. That is a judgment from the data; no scouting page could be opened in this pass. The body and leg internal splits are unsourced defaults. knee 0.03 is a low clinch default (8% of decayed attempts come in the clinch). No spinning or elbow finishes appear in his ufcstats record.

engine_notes.note: Takedown volume is far above the league: 18.3 attempts and 5.7 landed per 15 min career (20.6 and 4.95 decayed). The bantamweight league rate is about 4.7 attempts and 1.6 landed. Accuracy has dropped to 24% decayed, and Yan stopped 80 of 87 attempts over two fights.
Pace rises late: five-round landed-per-minute pace is 1.00 / 1.47 / 1.15 / 1.83 / 1.71 of round 1 over 7 five-round fights, vs a bantamweight prior of 1.00 / 1.32 / 1.32 / 1.37 / 1.53.

Very durable: one knockdown absorbed in 18 UFC fights (Marlon Moraes, R1, 2021) and no KO/TKO losses. His only stoppage loss is a 2018 technical submission (guillotine) by Ricky Simon at the final bell.

Control comes in short bursts rather than long rides: 20 s/min career, 15.9 decayed, vs about 10.6 for the league. He re-shoots rather than holding position: 10:03 vs O'Malley in 2024 but only 1:54 at UFC 333.
